    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:12.480
    | text      = My bright spot is I'm fucking around and thinking about bringing back a matter of time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:18.079
    | text      = Because I accidentally discovered that MacGyver is unstreaming. Classic MacGyver.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:27.040
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:27.599
    | text      = And I said, why not? I'll watch the pilot of MacGyver.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:32.400
    | text      = Because why not?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:33.120
    | text      = I haven't seen MacGyver in a long time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:35.120
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:35.519
    | text      = I watched it when I was a kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:36.879
    | text      = Did you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:37.120
    | text      = A little bit. And I think there were more jokes about MacGyver than I actually watched.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:41.519
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:42.239
    | text      = I've seen definitely a few.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:44.719
    | text      = I also think a fair amount of them blur together with Walker, Texas Ranger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:48.799
    | text      = And so I'm not sure exactly what's Norris, what's Richard Dean Anderson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:55.200
    | text      = And so I turned it on. And I have to tell you, I was overwhelmed by the opening credits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:03.280
    | text      = It is so much boy stuff from my childhood.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:09.599
    | text      = It's just him doing a bunch of stuff that rambunctious boys might do in the opening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:17.039
    | text      = It's just great. It tickled something in my brain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:20.800
    | text      = And I love it. I can't wait to watch however many seasons there are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:27.520
    | text      = I don't believe I've ever seen a full episode of MacGyver, but I've seen the last eight minutes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:33.039
    | text      = of 15 episodes of MacGyver, and they are very similar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:39.120
    | text      = I know that I've watched plenty. Enough to answer this question that I don't really know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:45.439
    | text      = And that is, what does he do? Watch the pilot. I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:53.280
    | text      = I feel like he's an independent contractor in some way. He's not wholly working for the force.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:01.120
    | text      = Well, the government definitely tells him, we need you to do something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:05.439
    | text      = And then he is also told, you can turn down this job. You don't have to do this. This is crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:11.520
    | text      = It's a very strange relationship he has with the government. Almost like altruistic in a sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:17.039
    | text      = He's like, ah, the government needs me again. I'll just help them out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:19.599
    | text      = Yeah. So in this one, there's an explosion in a negative third floor chemical plant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:28.319
    | text      = And it turns out that it was sabotaged by the head scientist because he had created a way to get rid
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:34.159
    | text      = of the ozone layer accidentally, and he didn't want it to fall into the wrong hands. So he lured
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:40.319
    | text      = the only other scientist in the world who understood what he was working on to his lab,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:47.680
    | text      = played a chess game with him, and then blew it up. So they both died?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:51.840
    | text      = No, they both survived. They both survived? Oh no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:55.199
    | text      = A lot of other people died, but they survived, so MacGyver's got to go down and get them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:59.919
    | text      = Roll by car.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:02.879
    | text      = And there's a chemical leak. And so the military is going to shoot a missile at them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:08.319
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:08.800
    | text      = He doesn't get the wrong time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:10.400
    | text      = This is a hell of a pilot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:13.919
    | text      = And while he's down there, he meets the assistant to one of these scientists, this lady.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:20.079
    | text      = And she is like the gal from Indiana Jones. She's an adventurer type. She's ready to go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:28.480
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:29.600
    | text      = They kiss like three times.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:31.279
    | text      = I'm sorry?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:32.079
    | text      = I googled it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:32.720
    | text      = Do they know each other?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:34.000
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:34.560
    | text      = Wow. That's quick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:35.759
    | text      = They thought they were going to die, and she's like, I just want to thank you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:38.079
    | text      = Oh, that's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:39.040
    | text      = And then they kissed two more times.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:40.480
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:40.959
    | text      = And I googled it, and she's not in another episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:45.439
    | text      = I mean, I hate to say this about MacGyver,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:49.600
    | text      = but perhaps his one character flaw is he likes to hit it and quit it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:07.680

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:16.319
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:16.879
    | text      = I worry about how much I'm going to uncover about things from my cantankerous young boy phases.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:25.839
    | text      = Eras of life that I'm like, oh wait, that was all just MacGyver.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:31.839

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.960
    | text      = We need that.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:06.240
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:06.639
    | text      = So laying in bed for a few days, I had the thought, you know, I was sick enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.519
    | text      = Let's get wacky.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.960
    | text      = So as soon as I got to feeling better, I got straight to this task and I wasn't going to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.960
    | text      = accept anything short of succeeding.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:19.840
    | text      = And it didn't take me long to strike gold.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.320
    | text      = On September 1st, Tucker Carlson released an interview with a former journalist named
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.480
    | text      = Lee Strobel entitled quote, possessions, miracles, visions, and encounters with angels and demons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.639
    | text      = And I said, say less.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.159
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.639
    | text      = No, I'm in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.600
    | text      = I, I, you stop drilling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.759
    | text      = You have hit oil, my friend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.279
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.080
    | text      = We all know Tucker was recently attacked by a demon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.360
    | text      = Recently attacked by a demon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.320
    | text      = This is finally him learning more about how to fight back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.279
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.519
    | text      = This is great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:48.159
    | text      = And an opportunity for him to open up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.240
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.799
    | text      = This is going to be awesome.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.279
    | text      = Tell us more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.919
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:52.559
    | text      = So what do you think about demons?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:57.440
    | text      = You know, traditionally against them, but maybe they're misunderstood.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:02.240
    | text      = You know, I feel like perhaps we've gotten trapped in a dogmatic idea of good versus
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.639
    | text      = evil and maybe that is a kept us from evolving as a species and demons are a fundamental
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.120
    | text      = aspect of something that we need to address as something part of our insights.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.039
    | text      = I'll spoil this for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.080
    | text      = Lee is opposed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.120
    | text      = Opposed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.600
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.840
    | text      = Well then I'll go with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.879
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.200
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.600
    | text      = So we start off here with Tucker giving a little bit of a, a little bit of an intro,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.399
    | text      = a Psalms guest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.600
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.320
    | text      = So we're told there's no state religion in the West, certainly not in the United States,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.240
    | text      = but in fact there is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:31.360
    | text      = It's scientism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.320
    | text      = It's the worship of science.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.240
    | text      = It's the belief, and all of us learn this at a young age, that everything around us,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.639
    | text      = everything we experience can be measured by people in white coats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.200
    | text      = That's science.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.000
    | text      = If it can't be measured, it's not real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.559
    | text      = The problem with this religion is that our life, our daily experience contradicts it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.799
    | text      = So belief in science does not require a person to think that our current understanding of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.799
    | text      = science is capable of explaining everything in the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.840
    | text      = This is a semantic game that Tucker is playing where he's imposing on his opponents a position
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.559
    | text      = that they don't hold.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.159
    | text      = Science can explain a lot and it can explain a shitload more than it could a hundred years
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:09.840
    | text      = ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.159
    | text      = So anyone who's not a dipshit would understand that in a hundred years, we'll be able to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.519
    | text      = explain a lot more than we can now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.320
    | text      = Science doesn't purport to be able to explain everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.960
    | text      = Although most people who are into reality probably would concede that almost everything
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.600
    | text      = could be explained if we understood how everything worked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.960
    | text      = Probably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.759
    | text      = Science is about repeatability for the most part.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:30.559
    | text      = It's a process that takes ideas and tests them to see if they reach valid conclusions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.440
    | text      = What I mean is that science doesn't just say that antibiotics kill infections and therefore
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.919
    | text      = this must be so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.759
    | text      = Rigorous trials and repeated studies that tested antibiotics against infections arrived at
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:46.240
    | text      = that conclusion that they were effective in fighting them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.559
    | text      = So that's become science's position.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.200
    | text      = If new repeatable credible information were to come to light that indicated that they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.039
    | text      = didn't work that way, science would change with that new information.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.919
    | text      = Science isn't a religion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.039
    | text      = And this formulation is actually Tucker hiding the ball about what his actual argument is,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:05.519
    | text      = which we'll get to as we go along.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.840
    | text      = As for the unexplained things that we experience in our day-to-day life, some of that can probably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:13.279
    | text      = be explained by science you just don't understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.159
    | text      = Other parts of it might be stuff that can't be explained by our current body of scientific
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:20.159
    | text      = knowledge, but will be explained by a new discovery that's just waiting to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.720
    | text      = Or it could be magic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:27.120
    | text      = It's possible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:28.320
    | text      = It is possible that we could all be in some sense particles given mass by Higgs field
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.039
    | text      = and that in a certain sense we are just moving through jello up and down like a wave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.519
    | text      = Or of course, could be God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.240
    | text      = Could be magic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:48.399
    | text      = Any of these things are possible and scienceism is a cult.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:51.519
    | text      = That does make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:52.559
    | text      = And all you need to know is that we're all having supernatural experiences all the fucking time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.279
    | text      = That sounds true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.559
    | text      = Constantly all of us are seeing, hearing, tasting, feeling things that can't be measured by science,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:07.759
    | text      = but it doesn't make them any less real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.919
    | text      = These are by definition supernatural.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:12.639
    | text      = Supernatural experiences are a feature of everyone's life and if we're honest we'll admit that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:18.720
    | text      = Tucker is saying that we're seeing, hearing, tasting, and feeling things that cannot be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.279
    | text      = measured by science, which is strange because that's all of our senses except smell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:27.840
    | text      = Why aren't people smelling supernatural stuff?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:31.919
    | text      = Okay, all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:33.679
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.840
    | text      = I'm gonna follow this train of thought.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:38.639
    | text      = Please.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.360
    | text      = If everyone experiences the supernatural, does it not then no longer deserve the term super?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:48.799
    | text      = It's just natural in a way that we don't understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.759
    | text      = Yeah, it's just natural.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:53.039
    | text      = Or not even that, if you're tasting something then we can measure how spicy it is, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:58.399
    | text      = Sure, there's capsaicin levels and scoville units.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:02.960
    | text      = Yeah, many of the things that you are seeing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:05.440
    | text      = tasting, feeling are in fact very measurable by your own senses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:10.720
    | text      = Tucker isn't talking about tasting a ghost or something here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:14.320
    | text      = This is actually just a reference to an idea in Lee Strobel's book,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.600
    | text      = where someone he's interviewing blows his mind by telling him that science can't describe the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.679
    | text      = smell of coffee.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.200
    | text      = Sensory experiences are tough to capture in words,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:25.840
    | text      = largely because there's a disconnect between an experience and the awareness of the experience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.600
    | text      = Every person's reaction to a description of coffee relies on their subjective take on it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:36.240
    | text      = so putting that subjective description into more objective terms is difficult.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:40.559
    | text      = But that doesn't mean that science can't explain why something smells the way they do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.120
    | text      = This is fairly basic stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:46.960
    | text      = It's something that we use so effectively that most people probably don't even realize it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:51.519
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:52.000
    | text      = For instance, natural gas is odorless, but it's also super dangerous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:56.320
    | text      = Can we measure it with science?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.000
    | text      = Well, when companies produce it, they add an odorizer to the gas
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.159
    | text      = so people can detect a leak more easily.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.879
    | text      = They can do that because the scientific method has uncovered various compounds that have certain
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.279
    | text      = smells. Your experience of smelling one of these odorizers may be different from mine,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:14.240
    | text      = but the arrangement of atoms that create the stimulus that we describe differently is science.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:20.720
    | text      = Anyway, the point is that we aren't constantly running around having supernatural experiences.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.759
    | text      = If you want to add some importance to the unique experience of tasting a peach
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:29.679
    | text      = and that importance improves your life, then I wish you the best with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.039
    | text      = But that does not invalidate science, and you sound like an idiot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:36.480
    | text      = I appreciate anybody who could write an entire book that I think his thesis boils down to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:43.039
    | text      = Explain, example, with your science.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.639
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:49.440
    | text      = It does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:51.600
    | text      = Except it's a little dumb.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.879
    | text      = Yeah. I mean, ultimately it comes down to like, well, I don't understand this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:58.799
    | text      = prove that. Like, man, what are we doing here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:01.039
    | text      = And I think that we're going to have a tough time because I'm going to be real mean to Lee Strobel
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:07.200
    | text      = throughout this, but he seems like a pleasant man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:09.839
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:10.319
    | text      = I don't know anything about him except this interview and what I've read and his book and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:14.559
    | text      = stuff, but he seems like a happy person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:17.440
    | text      = Eh, he's all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.319
    | text      = He also seems probably worse than Tucker in some ways, but politer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:25.519
    | text      = I mean, I suppose you don't...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.319
    | text      = You know, if you write a book about how angels and demons are better than science,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.400
    | text      = I don't think I can let you off the hook, even if you're a polite guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:37.680
    | text      = Wait till you hear some of the shit he says.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.039
    | text      = I believe that. I believe that hard.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:40.720
    | text      = So here's the thing you need to know about Lee before Tucker brings him in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:44.799
    | text      = That is the most important thing is he likes to prove shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:48.640
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.440
    | text      = Because he's from journalism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.799
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:51.680
    | text      = Well, Lee Strobel was a reporter. He worked for the Chicago Tribune
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:56.319
    | text      = and left and became a pastor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.720
    | text      = So he has religious faith, but also a grounding in empiricism, the desire to prove things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:06.319
    | text      = He is the perfect person to write the book that he did about the supernatural.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:10.559
    | text      = That would be dreams, mystical dreams, near death experiences, miracles, ghosts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:16.960
    | text      = We set down them to hear just how common these experiences are and what they mean.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.759
    | text      = I hate to say it, but the themes growed on me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:27.680
    | text      = Really?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:28.160
    | text      = Tucker's theme song has grown on me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:29.680
    | text      = That little twang.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.720
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.279
    | text      = Well, it's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:32.480
    | text      = So this is already what Tucker is saying is already a huge problem for him because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:37.599
    | text      = he's trying to prove that Lee Strobel likes to live in the world of proven facts by saying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:41.680
    | text      = that he worked for a major newspaper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.440
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.920
    | text      = The mainstream media is supposed to be all spin and lies. So the fact that he worked
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:47.119
    | text      = for the Chicago Tribune should probably be a mark against him in Tucker's world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:51.599
    | text      = I guess the media is only the enemy of the people when you need it to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:54.960
    | text      = So Lee did work in journalism, but he hasn't since 1987.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:00.079
    | text      = At that point, he became involved with mega churches and writing Christian apologetics
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:04.000
    | text      = texts designed to argue why it's not irrational to believe in various tenets of the religion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:09.119
    | text      = There you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:09.759
    | text      = And I'm sure that most people know, but like apology in this case is not like...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:15.200
    | text      = It's not like, I'm sorry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:16.559
    | text      = No, no, no, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:17.440
    | text      = It's argumentative.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:18.400
    | text      = It's a defense of...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:20.799
    | text      = Physiognity makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.039
    | text      = I have no problem with him writing these kinds of texts, but it's deeply disingenuous to call
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.200
    | text      = in someone who's interested in empiricism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.599
    | text      = In a religious sense, Lee is an evangelist. And when religion and politics intersect,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.039
    | text      = as they do with Tucker, he's acting as a propagandist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.160
    | text      = I don't care about a person working at a newspaper almost 40 years ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.680
    | text      = So the presentation of Lee as a rational actor based on that piece of his resume,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.240
    | text      = it's not going to sway me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:47.680
    | text      = We'll see how he makes his arguments and presents his information. And from there,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:51.519
    | text      = we can see if this is an honest empiricist who just has to admit that magic is real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:56.240
    | text      = Or if he's a charlatan parading around in an empiricist costume,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:59.839
    | text      = feeding into a religious hysteria that's going to be used to persecute a ton of people for no reason.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:04.880
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:05.759
    | text      = We'll find out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:06.720
    | text      = You know what I was just thinking?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:08.160
    | text      = I was just thinking...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:08.640
    | text      = It's the second one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:09.440
    | text      = Here's what I'm doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:10.480
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:11.039
    | text      = I'm creating a farm system for these guys. This is my new plan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:14.799
    | text      = I hire a bunch...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.160
    | text      = Or I raise a bunch of youth group kids to think, go become a journalist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:21.279
    | text      = And then in eight years, you'll be the person I'm like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:24.240
    | text      = oh, come to the other side.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:25.680
    | text      = And you'll be like, I worked in journalism for eight years, and now I believe in the Lord.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.759
    | text      = But actually you did it the whole time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.599
    | text      = It was all a fucking ruse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:33.359
    | text      = And now you're brought up to the big game.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.799
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:35.200
    | text      = That's what I'm saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:36.480
    | text      = I don't think this is a bad idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:37.680
    | text      = Well, I think that there is some kind of...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:40.319
    | text      = What would Alex call that? Like sheep dipping?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.559
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:43.039
    | text      = Sheep dipping someone in credibility?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:44.640
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:45.680
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.000
    | text      = No, that's the way to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.279
    | text      = So Lee comes into the interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.480
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.960
    | text      = And...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:52.960
    | text      = Lee Strobooth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.000
    | text      = So you've written a book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.880
    | text      = I don't do a lot of book interviews.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:57.039
    | text      = I couldn't resist this one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:58.720
    | text      = Seeing the supernatural, investigating angels, demons, mystical dreams,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:04.480
    | text      = near-death encounters and other mysteries of the unseen world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:08.480
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:09.839
    | text      = I think a lot of us sense or know on some level...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:12.799
    | text      = In fact, I think everybody knows on some level that there is a world that science can't measure
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:18.400
    | text      = or quantify.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:19.200
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:20.000
    | text      = That there is...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:22.880
    | text      = There's stuff that we can't explain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:24.640
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:24.880
    | text      = But that it's no less real for our inability to explain it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:27.599
    | text      = So let's go through the list.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.839
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:30.400
    | text      = So the elephant in the room here is that Tucker has recently revealed that he was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:33.759
    | text      = attacked by a demon in his sleep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:35.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:35.920
    | text      = He did an interview with an orthodox documentarian about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:38.799
    | text      = So it's not just a poorly kept secret or something that Alex has gossiped about without permission.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:44.160
    | text      = Tucker's trying to insinuate that we all know that there are unseen things in the world that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:47.920
    | text      = science can't explain, but doesn't seem to want to tell Lee about his own very real and very
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:52.799
    | text      = serious experience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.720
    | text      = Lee has written a book about encounters with angels and demons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:57.440
    | text      = So Tucker could...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.640
    | text      = He could be a very useful resource when he was writing this book or now he's promoting it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.279
    | text      = I was gonna say, should have been consulted, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:05.839
    | text      = Tucker has so much evidence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:07.519
    | text      = I'm sure he took pictures of the claw marks and his wife can verify aspects of the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:11.440
    | text      = So it seems like a perfect situation for him and Lee.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:14.720
    | text      = Lee's the person most motivated to believe Tucker's story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:18.240
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:18.480
    | text      = And Tucker is the person who seems like he could provide Lee with solid evidence of a demon attack.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:23.359
