{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:34.900
    | text      = They're very intelligent, very smart.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:37.220
    | text      = No in-laws.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:38.900
    | text      = With what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:39.619
    | text      = There's no physical body.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:40.819
    | text      = To serve not only God, but also his people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:44.019
    | text      = And what's interesting...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:46.339
    | text      = The Christian Bible with the Hebrew Old Testament makes references.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:52.019
    | text      = Is there any culture in the world that doesn't believe in some form of angel?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:57.380
    | text      = It's pretty universal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:58.500
    | text      = Pretty universal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:59.299
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:59.859
    | text      = So now we're supposed to believe that Lee is coming from a position of a guy who is Christian faith,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:04.019
    | text      = but is also a man of empiricism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:06.019
    | text      = So the things that he's saying aren't just wacky ramblings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:08.740
    | text      = They're based in fact.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:09.779
    | text      = Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:10.980
    | text      = If you want to say that you believe that angels exist because of some incident where someone is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:15.220
    | text      = saved by an angel and there's no explanation that you can come up with for it, then I can
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:19.140
    | text      = accept that you're applying a critical mind to the situation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:21.700
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:22.420
    | text      = You're going off the rails and applying critical thinking poorly, but you're seeking an explanation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:26.819
    | text      = for something that you feel cannot be explained any other way, so you're left to assume,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:31.299
    | text      = well, maybe it was an angel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:32.579
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:33.140
    | text      = Conversely, if you're telling me that angels were created before humans, and you want to tell me
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:37.779
    | text      = about their biology and dating habits, then I'm no longer convinced that what you're saying is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:42.099
    | text      = the product of critical thinking.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:44.660
    | text      = As we go along, this is one of the crucial things to keep in mind because it reveals the lie that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:49.299
    | text      = all of this is based on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:50.980
    | text      = Lee is pretending that he's a good faith researcher who has seen stuff that just can't be explained
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:55.140
    | text      = by natural means.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:56.339
    | text      = So he's left with no choice but to consider the possibility that maybe the supernatural stuff
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:01.619
    | text      = is going on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:02.259
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:02.980
    | text      = But where in his exploration of trying to explain natural phenomena did he learn that angels
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:07.619
    | text      = don't get married?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:08.579
    | text      = Oh, well, because they can't fuck, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:12.579
    | text      = His argument is they don't marry because there's no physical body.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:16.579
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:17.220
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:17.460
    | text      = They don't age.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:18.180
    | text      = That's the concept.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:19.380
    | text      = Or they can't reproduce or whatever it is you'd like to say.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:21.779
    | text      = They never have to buy new clothes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:23.059
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:23.779
    | text      = Now, if I understand this correctly, though, where do they smart?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:30.180
    | text      = Do you know what I mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:30.900
    | text      = If there's no physical body, what is it that they keep their smarts in?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:36.099
    | text      = Like, we have a brain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:37.619
    | text      = We're not just, like, thinky.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:40.019
    | text      = I think they're spatial intelligence people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:42.500
    | text      = Is that how it works?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:44.099
    | text      = They just have existing space.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:46.660
    | text      = You know how, like, Turbo on the challenge is really good at, like, color puzzles?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:52.259
    | text      = That's true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:52.740
    | text      = And, like, he's just a machine at those things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:55.140
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:55.700
    | text      = Angels are like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:56.819
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:57.940
    | text      = That makes enough sense for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:01.059
    | text      = I'm in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:02.259
    | text      = Oh, boy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:03.140
    | text      = So this guy, I mean, like, we're already, like, only a couple of minutes into the interview,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:08.099
    | text      = and, like, you have abandoned the pretense of empiricism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.940
    | text      = Tell me more about the marriage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:13.539
    | text      = Tell me more about why they don't marry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:15.380
    | text      = Tell me if God was like, we should get ones that marry and ones that don't marry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:19.380
    | text      = What are we talking about here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:20.579
    | text      = Well, they don't marry because they don't have hands, and therefore no fingers,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:23.700
    | text      = so they can't have rings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:24.660
    | text      = They can't put the rings on the fingers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:26.019
    | text      = The ring is an essential part of the union.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:27.859
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:28.900
    | text      = You're not wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:29.619
    | text      = And then how would they kiss the bride?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:31.940
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:32.259
    | text      = They don't have a body.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:33.140
    | text      = No lips.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:33.700
    | text      = No lips.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:34.420
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:35.539
    | text      = So, you know who has lips?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:38.420
    | text      = MacGyver.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:38.900
    | text      = A Kardashian?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:41.140
    | text      = So, let's hear some more about some angels.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:44.180
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:44.579
    | text      = Like, maybe how they save missionaries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:46.500
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:47.299
    | text      = What's interesting about the Christian interpretation of angels is that in the book
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:52.259
    | text      = of Hebrews in the Bible, that we should anticipate the possibility that we would encounter an angel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:59.539
    | text      = In other words, it says sometimes when you're providing hospitality to someone,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:03.380
    | text      = unbeknownst to you, it's an angel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:06.259
    | text      = And so, there's an anticipation that perhaps there could be angelic encounters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:10.180
    | text      = And so, what I tried to look at in the book are cases in which we have angelic encounters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:16.500
    | text      = People actually encounter an angel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:18.500
    | text      = I'll give you an example.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:19.700
    | text      = There was a missionary named John G.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:21.539
    | text      = Peyton, P-A-T-O-N, from Scotland.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:24.099
    | text      = And he went to an island in the South Pacific to be a Christian missionary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:28.500
    | text      = And he and his wife were living in a cottage there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:31.220
    | text      = And he's talking about Jesus.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:32.740
    | text      = Well, the local tribes people didn't quite like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:35.619
    | text      = And so, one day a mob of them came to burn down their house and kill them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:40.500
    | text      = So, they see this mob forming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.420
    | text      = And he and his wife are in their house.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:44.660
    | text      = And what can they do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:45.859
    | text      = They start to praise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:47.140
    | text      = Like, God, protect us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:48.740
    | text      = Help us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:50.180
    | text      = They're going to kill us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:50.819
    | text      = They're going to burn our house down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:51.859
    | text      = What do we do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:52.740
    | text      = And they prayed all night long.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:55.059
    | text      = And by dawn, the mob began to dissipate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:59.220
    | text      = A year later, he led the head of that mob to faith in Jesus Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:03.539
    | text      = Oh, my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:04.259
    | text      = And they're having a conversation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:05.779
    | text      = And John said, by the way, do you remember that day when you all came to burn down our
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:10.260
    | text      = house and kill us?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:11.460
    | text      = Why didn't you do it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:13.460
    | text      = And the man said, well, who are all those men you had there?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:17.059
    | text      = He said, no, no, man, it was just my wife and I.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:20.820
    | text      = Your house was surrounded by these muscular men and white guys with drawn swords.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:26.179
    | text      = There's no way we could have hurt you that night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:28.340
    | text      = Injected in my veins.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:29.940
    | text      = Well, what's the explanation for that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:32.500
    | text      = I think it could very well have been an angelic encounter that God had sent angels to protect
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:37.619
    | text      = him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:38.260
    | text      = It only makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:39.139
    | text      = That's the only thing I can think of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:40.980
    | text      = That's the only explanation I can think of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:42.579
    | text      = I think you and I are both having, like, flashbacks to bullshit stories people told us when we
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:47.940
    | text      = were in youth groups.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:48.739
    | text      = So many of these.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:51.219
    | text      = And it's always, it's always the, and then they prayed all night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:55.219
    | text      = It's all night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:56.659
    | text      = It's never they prayed for a couple hours.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:58.500
    | text      = It's never they prayed for two nights.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:00.659
    | text      = It's always the whole night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:02.420
    | text      = God needs the full eight hours, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:05.380
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:05.780
    | text      = And if you clock out early, the mob's coming in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:08.500
    | text      = Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:09.059
    | text      = You're done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:09.619
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:10.420
    | text      = When Lee asks, what's the explanation here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:13.780
    | text      = It's key to remember that he's not really asking a question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:16.820
    | text      = He's arguing that angels were protecting this guy's house and there's no other possible
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:21.059
    | text      = explanation that we can come up with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:23.300
    | text      = This is a cute anecdote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:24.579
    | text      = And I remember hearing shit like this all the time in youth group, because these are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:27.780
    | text      = stories meant to appease the audience of the faithful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:30.820
    | text      = This is the type of content you throw out to literally preach to the choir because no
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.500
    | text      = one else is going to be persuaded by this at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:37.539
    | text      = For one thing, this is a third hand story at best.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:40.900
    | text      = The mob leader is telling the missionary about something he allegedly saw.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:44.579
    | text      = Then the missionary is retelling the story and Lee is retelling hearing about the missionary's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:49.300
    | text      = story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:49.699
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:50.260
    | text      = This game of telephone doesn't inspire confidence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:53.139
    | text      = Further, you notice that Lee knows the missionary's name, but not the guy who saw the angels.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:58.579
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:59.219
    | text      = That's suspicious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:02.019
    | text      = So Lee uses this anecdote in his book to argue for the existence of angels, but he doesn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:06.739
    | text      = use the testimony of the guy who saw the angels or even the missionary, John Gilbert Patton.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:12.420
    | text      = He cites Billy Graham discussing Patton's story, which is another layer of interpretation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:17.860
    | text      = which is being added to this whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:19.539
    | text      = Including Billy Graham, which increases the likelihood of truth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:23.619
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:24.500
    | text      = Billy Graham used this story in his 1975 book Angels, God's Secret Agents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:30.260
    | text      = Lee is just taking Graham's version of the whole thing, which isn't very inquisitive
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:33.860
    | text      = of him and makes me think that he doesn't care for empiricism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:37.380
    | text      = This is because John Gilbert Patton wrote an autobiography that was published in 1889
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:43.699
    | text      = and this story is in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:45.539
    | text      = You aren't going to get the account of the random mob leader who supposedly saw angels,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:49.619
    | text      = but Patton's story is closer to the event than Graham's retelling of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:54.019
    | text      = So Lee should have consulted that for his book as opposed to Billy Graham's version
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:59.380
    | text      = of the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:00.019
    | text      = You'd think.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:00.659
    | text      = Because if he had done that, he would find that Graham is mistelling the story and there's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:04.019
    | text      = no angels in it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:04.980
    | text      = Oh, what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:06.260
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:07.059
    | text      = So to set the scene, Patton and his associates were setting up a mission in the new Hebrides.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:12.579
    | text      = There's some islands in the vicinity of Australia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:15.059
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:15.619
    | text      = For the most part, the native population accepted merchants and missionaries, but there had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:19.699
    | text      = been a flare up recently due to a quarrel between sandalwood merchants and some locals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:24.099
    | text      = That'll happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:24.820
    | text      = This led to some murders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:26.019
    | text      = Hey, what you gonna do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:26.980
    | text      = In the aftermath of that, it looked like a full-on war was going to break out, but tensions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:31.780
    | text      = lowered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:32.820
    | text      = All the same, Patton's mission wasn't viewed the same after that, and a lot of people on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:37.219
    | text      = the island viewed him as the enemy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:38.820
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:39.539
    | text      = A while after that, a chief from another island came to visit and died shortly after returning
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:44.500
    | text      = home.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:44.739
    | text      = Eee, that's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:46.019
    | text      = Some people, quote, hearing of his death ascribed it to me and the worship and resolved to burn
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:51.139
    | text      = our house and property and either murder the whole mission party or compel us to leave
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:55.380
    | text      = the island.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:55.860
    | text      = I mean, it does make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:57.380
    | text      = Well, there's at least a little bit more of an A to B.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:59.780
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:00.659
    | text      = It's like, sure, you can believe in angels.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:02.659
    | text      = I believe that this happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:03.940
    | text      = We just move on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:04.739
    | text      = That's how it works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:05.780
    | text      = So at this point, Patton had some allies among the native population, like a chief named
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:10.579
    | text      = Nawat, who spoke in Patton's defense and tried to get them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:14.260
    | text      = Hey, don't burn down his house.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:14.980
    | text      = Hey, come on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:15.380
    | text      = This guy's just one of...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:16.260
    | text      = He's just a guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:16.980
    | text      = Yeah, but it wasn't enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:18.900
    | text      = Quote, the inhabitants from miles around united in seeking our destruction, but God put to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:23.860
    | text      = it even savage hearts to save us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:26.420
    | text      = A meeting of all our enemies on the island was summoned, and it was publicly resolved
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:30.420
    | text      = that a band of men be selected and enjoined to kill the whole of those friendly to the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:34.420
    | text      = mission.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:35.539
    | text      = Frenzy and excitement prevailed, and the blood fiend seemed to override the whole assembly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:40.659
    | text      = When under the impulse that surely came from the Lord of Pity, one great warrior chief
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:44.980
    | text      = who had hitherto kept silent rose, swung aloft a mighty club and smashed it earthwards, cried
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:50.900
    | text      = aloud, the man who kills Meecee must kill me first.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:54.579
    | text      = The man that killed the mission teachers must kill me first and my people, for we shall
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:58.579
    | text      = stand by them and defend them till death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:00.739
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:01.719
    | text      = So the guy who stands up for them ends up getting a slow clap of the chiefs who are
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:06.920
    | text      = all like, we got his back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:08.039
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:08.679
    | text      = We got the missionaries back and then the mission saved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:11.000
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:12.440
    | text      = So let me follow this evolution, if you will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:16.360
    | text      = So in this real story, well, as real as we're gonna get out of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:21.559
    | text      = I mean, it's a late 1800s autobiography by a missionary who seems to think that he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:27.800
    | text      = part adventurer, which is kind of a fun tone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:31.400
    | text      = He also doesn't seem to hate native populations, but also kind of hates them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:35.719
    | text      = I mean, what are you gonna do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:36.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:37.320
    | text      = But the point being, the native population is all doing what they do and the hero of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:44.679
    | text      = the story is one of those people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:46.760
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:47.960
    | text      = And obviously you're gonna say he's moved by the Lord of Pity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:52.599
    | text      = God moved his heart to protect them, but it is out of the goodness of these chiefs standing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.280
    | text      = up for them and protecting them that they didn't have their mission burned.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:03.000
    | text      = So then notoriously white supremacist Christian Billy Graham gets a hold of this story and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:09.079
    | text      = those men are no longer native, but in fact, white roped white people holding swords?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.920
    | text      = Muscular.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:16.280
    | text      = That's crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:17.320
    | text      = That is just crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:19.239
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:19.639
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:19.960
    | text      = So in his story, Patton says, quote, clearly did our Lord Jesus Christ interpose directly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:24.760
    | text      = on our behalf that day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:26.199
    | text      = I and my defenseless company had spent it in anxious prayers and tears and our hearts
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:30.760
    | text      = overflowed with gratitude to the savior who rescued us from the lion's jaws.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:35.800
    | text      = So when Lee tells the story and asks, what's the explanation?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:39.159
    | text      = I find his disposition to be dishonest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:42.360
    | text      = The explanation is obvious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:44.679
    | text      = A missionary who died in 1907 wrote an autobiography that at times reads like Tin Tin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:50.840
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:51.239
    | text      = And then a craven evangelist came along and embellished the story for his own book about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:56.039
    | text      = angels being secret agents for God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:57.880
    | text      = Explain that with your science.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:00.199
    | text      = Lee isn't interested in digging down to uncover truth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:02.840
    | text      = He's just financially invested in perpetuating the same shit Billy Graham was pursuing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:07.159
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:07.559
    | text      = And man, I might read the rest of that guy's autobiography.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:13.880
    | text      = I mean, that sounds fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.239
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.480
    | text      = Those old timey adventure stories are truly great and a lot of them have some truth to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:21.079
    | text      = them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:21.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:21.800
    | text      = And he seemed like an unreliable narrator, but like in a fun way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:26.840
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:27.079
    | text      = They're all really unreliable narrators because they're just white people having a grand time
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:32.039
    | text      = in the late 19th century.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:33.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:33.800
    | text      = What are you going to do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:34.360
    | text      = It's long enough ago that I think I can chuckle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:37.079
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:38.440
    | text      = But also it's horrible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:38.920
    | text      = Can't do anything about it now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:40.199
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:40.599
    | text      = Let's just face it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:41.320
    | text      = There's no going back now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:44.440
    | text      = So I think that this story sucks and Lee's argument for angels still at zero.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:50.599
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:51.480
    | text      = But Tucker is like, fuck, yeah, give me another one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:53.960
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:54.519
    | text      = And there's multiple numbers of cases like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:58.920
    | text      = Give me another.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:59.880
    | text      = Well, I had an encounter myself when I was 12 years old.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:05.960
    | text      = It was the only dream I remember as a child.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:07.800
    | text      = It was more of a vision than a dream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:10.360
    | text      = An angel appeared to me and started extolling heaven.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:13.719
    | text      = How beautiful and wonderful heaven is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:15.800
    | text      = And I looked at him kind of offhandedly and said, well, you know, I'm going to go there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:19.320
    | text      = someday.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:20.360
    | text      = And he looked at me, he said, how do you know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:22.840
    | text      = And I was shocked by that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:23.719
    | text      = Well, how do I know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:25.400
    | text      = And I started to kind of stumble around to justify my goodness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:28.440
    | text      = I said, well, I obey my parents pretty much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:31.239
    | text      = I get good grades in school and my friends like me and I'm trying to justify why I would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:35.400
    | text      = get into heaven.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:36.519
    | text      = And he looked at me and he said, that doesn't matter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:40.039
    | text      = And this chill went through my spine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:42.679
    | text      = How can this not matter?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:44.920
    | text      = And he said, someday you'll understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:47.559
    | text      = And then disappeared.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:49.480
    | text      = Well, I kind of wrote it off as being a bad pizza and ultimately became an atheist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:55.079
    | text      = But 16 years later, as an atheist, my wife brought me to a church and I heard the gospel
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:00.920
    | text      = for the first time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:02.280
    | text      = That salvation, that the doors of heaven are not flung open based on how nice you are to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:06.519
    | text      = your parents or how good grades you get in school.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:10.440
    | text      = It's based on the grace of God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:12.280
    | text      = It's not something we earn.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:13.320
    | text      = It's a free gift of God's grace.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:15.719
    | text      = And I heard that message for the first time and my mind flashed back to that dream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:19.960
    | text      = And I thought, wait a minute.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:22.199
    | text      = That's what he was trying to tell me back then.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:23.800
    | text      = Have you thought a lot about that dream in the subsequent years?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:25.639
    | text      = It would come to me every once in a while.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:27.000
    | text      = I think about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:27.559
    | text      = I just suppress it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:28.360
    | text      = Well, it was a bad pizza, you know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:31.079
    | text      = But then I thought there's two forms of corroboration there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:33.719
    | text      = Number one, that angel told me something when I was 12 years old.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:38.360
    | text      = I did not already know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:40.440
    | text      = Fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:40.840
    | text      = That salvation is by grace.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:42.119
    | text      = I'll count that one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:43.400
    | text      = He made a prophecy, a prediction that someday I would understand that came true 16 years later.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:48.440
    | text      = Boom.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:49.400
    | text      = I think that may have been an angelic encounter that I had.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:53.320
    | text      = I can't prove it, but that corroboration tells me maybe it really was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:57.639
    | text      = I'm sorry, but I don't care about this dream at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:00.039

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:30.920

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:41.800
    | text      = You can't prove a negative, which is why you can't put the burden of proof onto a position
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:46.360
    | text      = that requires you to do that in order to establish that position.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
